auth.title: Unlock your shared space
auth.description: This space is protected. Enter the password provided by the administrator to transfer files and share your clipboard.
auth.sessionNote: Stay unlocked for 12 hours in this browser only.
auth.footer: Let files and ideas flow between your devices.
auth.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Please try again shortly.
auth.unavailable: Unable to connect. Check your network and try again.
auth.expired: Your session has expired. Enter the password again.
拖入文件或文件夹，保留目录结构。支持多文件队列、暂停和失败重试。: Drop files or folders while preserving their structure. Queue multiple files, pause uploads, and retry failures.
查找、下载和管理已上传的文件，随时了解文件大小与磁盘空间。: Find, download, and manage uploaded files. Check file sizes and available disk space.
粘贴并发布一段文字，在另一台设备查看和复制，历史记录自动保存。: Paste and publish text to view and copy on another device. History is saved automatically.
在设备之间，分享文件与文字。: Share files and text between devices.
上传文件、管理已上传内容，或用共享剪贴板传递一段文字。: Upload and manage files, or send text through the shared clipboard.
在另一台可访问此服务的设备上打开相同地址，即可下载文件或查看共享文本。剪贴板页面: Open the same address on another device that can access this service to download files or view shared text. The clipboard updates automatically, and you can refresh it manually.
支持拖入文件夹并保留目录结构，切换页面后仍会继续上传: Drop folders to preserve their structure. Uploads continue when you switch pages.
选择要上传的文件，支持多选: Choose files to upload; multiple selection supported
拖放文件或文件夹到此处或点击浏览: Drop files or folders here, or click to browse
拖放文件或文件夹，或点击\"选择文件\"按钮；空文件夹不会上传: Drop files or folders, or click "Choose files". Empty folders are skipped.
本轮队列耗时，不含暂停时间: Time spent on this queue, excluding pauses
磁盘使用率已超过 85%，请及时清理文件。: Disk usage exceeds 85%. Please free up space.
在设备之间分享文本和图片，粘贴、发布，然后在另一台设备上复制。: Share text and images between devices: paste, publish, then copy on another device.
本次发布图片，文本草稿将保留。移除图片后可发布文本。: Publishing an image will keep your text draft. Remove the image to publish text.
无法直接复制图片，请使用 HTTPS 或 localhost 并允许剪贴板权限；: To copy images directly, use HTTPS or localhost and allow clipboard access. You can also open or download the image to copy it manually.
无法自动复制，请复制下方已选中的文本（Ctrl+C / ⌘C，或长按复制）。: Automatic copying is unavailable. Copy the selected text below (Ctrl+C / ⌘C, or press and hold).
最多保留 100 条，超出后自动淘汰最旧记录。: Up to 100 entries are kept. The oldest entries are removed automatically.
操作期间暂停自动更新: Automatic updates paused during this operation
自动更新暂不可用，已保留当前内容，将稍后重试。: Automatic updates are temporarily unavailable. Current content is preserved; retrying later.
确定删除所有设备共享的全部记录？删除后无法恢复。: Delete all entries shared across devices? This cannot be undone.
还没有共享内容，发布第一段文本吧。: Nothing shared yet. Publish your first text.
图片加载失败，可打开图片重试: Image failed to load. Open the image to retry.
选择图片，或在本页按 Ctrl+V / ⌘V 粘贴截图: Choose an image, or paste a screenshot on this page with Ctrl+V / ⌘V
请选择限制大小内的 PNG 或 JPEG 图片。: Choose a PNG or JPEG image within the size limit.
